prerequisites: The second section of study must have been reached, requiring at least 42 ECTS credits from the first section of study.

learning_outcomes.text: Expand understanding of the fundamentals in discrete mathematics.
Prepare for advanced subjects in applied and theoretical computer science.
Provide (discrete) algorithmic procedures for applications within and outside of computer science using selected topics from discrete mathematics.
Name fundamental mathematical concepts, their properties and relationships, and algorithms based on them.
Explain concepts, relationships, and algorithms using examples and understand their essential functionalities.
Recognize the meaning and benefit of mathematical formula notation in describing and treating application problems.
Recognize fundamental mathematical problems arising in the processing of application problems and solve them with appropriate methods.
Critically question results regarding their mathematical correctness.
Critically examine and evaluate results regarding their implications for the underlying application problems.

syllabus_topics: Graph Theory: Undirected and directed graphs
Graph Theory: Applications of graph theory
Elementary Number Theory: Natural, integer, and prime numbers
Elementary Number Theory: Divisibility and congruence
Elementary Number Theory: Chinese Remainder Theorem
Elementary Number Theory: Quadratic reciprocity law
Order and Lattice Theory: Relations, orders, and partial orders
Order and Lattice Theory: Equivalence relations, equivalence classes, and quotient sets
Order and Lattice Theory: Knaster-Tarski fixed-point theorem
